about: Lumbridge church and its graveyard, east of the castle: Father Aereck (father_aereck, 2812) inside and Count Check (count_check, 7414) south-west of the graveyard. Since 242.1 (Wiki update notes, 3 November 2026) the Prayer tutor is gone (Father Aereck gives the tips) and Nigel stands at the Grand Exchange on normal worlds (varrock.json). Tiles are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, checked against the 241 map (the church's walls and pews). Every wander range is guessed (2, Father Aereck 5 inside) until recorded.

spawns.source: Father Aereck, in the church by the altar. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
Count Check, south-west of the graveyard. RSMod rev 233 Lumbridge spawns
